static_runtime_report.limits: Static reports retain population/recursive unknown upper bounds. Counts are not measured idle work, MSPT or command-budget units.

review_contracts: Consumer State owns zero lower bound, matching capacity upper bound, defaults, persistence and auto-ticking.
Bind resource, cooldown and eligibility to the same current player; synchronous search uses one terminal acceptance callback.
One maintenance registration identity per shared pool; duplicate identity fails export. Different identities schedule independent work.
Eligibility and target acceptance precede one grouped cost/cooldown/effects branch; later native failure or callback return does not roll back payment.
Construction/discard exports are byte-identical to the same State baseline; registration is distinct from runtime invocation.
limitations: Console-driven activation with passive real clients; no client-input or death/respawn proof.
No asynchronous target reservation, native rollback, MSPT, population-capacity or command-budget guarantee.
Broader #386 families remain open. Indexed owner storage and reclamation are outside workstream A.
